name: ray-claude-code-mods
description: Ray's Claude Code mods: panes, bands and guards built on function hooks.

plugins.name: diff-explorer
plugins.description: A VS Code-style side panel for the files Claude changes: a file tree with Material-style icons and a GitHub-dark diff preview. /diffs opens it.

plugins.name: mod-manager
plugins.description: Your installed Claude Code mods in one pane: browse them with their READMEs, switch each on or off, and open their panels. /mods opens it.

plugins.name: prompt-history
plugins.description: The prompts you typed this session, listed beside the chat with how long ago you sent each; click one to read it in full and jump back to it. /prompts opens it.
